job.rawJd:
General UX and product-design networking profile, not an employer posting.

Audience: design leaders considering senior UX, product design, experience strategy, design-system, and design-leadership talent.

Core work: turn research, complex workflows, and business goals into clear product experiences; build reusable design systems; make data-heavy products easier to use; work across discovery, prototypes, validation, and engineering handoff; and guide cross-functional product delivery.

Resume architecture: lead with enterprise UX, design systems, research, team growth, and hands-on product delivery across One Block Away, Hedgehox, Kinesso, Omnicom, and Heartbeat. Keep AI as a current product-building context, not as a substitute for design evidence. Earlier account leadership supports stakeholder and delivery credibility.

This package must be fit-gated again against any future employer job description.

The AI/Product Implementation evidence pool still provides the direct UX, research, design-system, enterprise-product, workflow-design, and hands-on delivery evidence. Earlier account leadership remains supporting context.

supportedOverlap: The portfolio shows research, journey mapping, information architecture, workflows, prototypes, design systems, accessibility, final interfaces, and engineering handoff.

Research proof includes a practice built across 20+ products using interviews, prototype testing, behavioral data, workshops, roadshows, and reusable Figma documentation.
Current work connects discovery, product strategy, UX, AI workflow design, working prototypes, demo readiness, and client iteration.

missingEvidence: No employer-specific job description was provided, so this package is a general design-networking artifact rather than an ATS match for one opening.

coverLetterBridge.rationale: This is a direct, portfolio-primary design profile rather than an employer application. The resume and selected work already establish the design story, and there is no job-specific gap for a cover letter to address.

fitGate.recommendation: Use this as the general UX and product-design resume for design-leadership introductions. Build a separate employer package only when a specific job description materially changes the evidence or positioning.

positioning.employerNeed: Turn research and complex workflows into clear, accessible product experiences and reusable systems that teams can build and scale.
